info.text:
Private equity did more than 9,000 US deals in 2025 (PitchBook, including add-ons), about 25 a day, from vet clinics and dental offices to plumbers, homes, hospitals, software and sports teams. This video explains from zero how a PE fund works (GPs, LPs and 2 and 20), walks through a hypothetical leveraged buyout with the full math, and compares global buyout value in 2024 and 2025 (Bain, excluding add-ons). Then it lays out what peer-reviewed research found on both sides: productivity gains and cleaner restaurants, but higher death rates in PE-owned nursing homes and more hospital-acquired conditions after hospital buyouts.
